# Commands (index)

Agent 执行单条 `llm-wiki` 子命令时**不要**加载本文件全文；只加载：

1. `references/commands/_shared.md`
2. `references/commands/<command>.md`（与当前子命令对应）

完整协议已按命令拆分在 `references/commands/` 目录。

| 子命令 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| `llm-wiki add-code` | [`add-code.md`](./commands/add-code.md) |
| `llm-wiki add-wiki` | [`add-wiki.md`](./commands/add-wiki.md) |
| `llm-wiki backfill` | [`backfill.md`](./commands/backfill.md) |
| `llm-wiki code-trace` | [`code-trace.md`](./commands/code-trace.md) |
| `llm-wiki doctor` | [`doctor.md`](./commands/doctor.md) |
| `llm-wiki fast` | [`fast.md`](./commands/fast.md) |
| `llm-wiki image` | [`image.md`](./commands/image.md) |
| `llm-wiki init` | [`init.md`](./commands/init.md) |
| `llm-wiki maintain-all` | [`maintain-all.md`](./commands/maintain-all.md) |
| `llm-wiki query-plus` | [`query-plus.md`](./commands/query-plus.md) |
| `llm-wiki query` | [`query.md`](./commands/query.md) |
| `llm-wiki refine` | [`refine.md`](./commands/refine.md) |
| `llm-wiki review-requirement` | [`review-requirement.md`](./commands/review-requirement.md) |
| `llm-wiki update-skill` | [`update-skill.md`](./commands/update-skill.md) |
| `llm-wiki update` | [`update.md`](./commands/update.md) |
